intent: welcome and the transient agent_state snapshot optionally carry box identity metadata — harness kind, model id, effort knob — so clients can detect and display which model the box runs AND whether it is the SDK edition vs the TUI vs pi. All three fields are optional and additive: absent = unknown (old boxes render nothing new). welcome guarantees an idle box displays correctly on every (re)connect; agent_state gives live refresh when the claude-sdk harness resolves its model AFTER a device is already attached (harness_info over the run child's stdio). Old app + new box: unknown JSON keys are ignored. New app + old box: fields absent, chip renders nothing. The relay is a dumb pipe and never sees inside the encrypted envelope.

assertions.statement: harness is one of claude|claude-sdk|pi|opencode today, but clients accept any ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$ token for forward compatibility; claude means the TUI.
model is the resolved or configured model id (<=64 chars), omitted when unknown; effort is the operator effort knob verbatim (<=16 chars), omitted when unknown or numeric-custom.
a client sanitizes rather than rejects: an invalid metadata value is stripped from the parsed frame, never a reason to fail the connection handshake.
the same three fields ride agent_state.state next to name (FB21/FB35 precedent); each snapshot is a full replacement and restamps them when present.

expect.note: old box: no metadata, chip renders nothing
idle box still announces identity: an agent_state whose only content is harness identity is emitted, not suppressed
